import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import App, { parseEquipCommand } from '@src/response-apps/equipment/equipItem/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { withBackendRepeatDetection } from '@src/utils/backendRepeatDetector';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import { Format, logger, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

/**
 * 装备{装备名}或装备{储物装备的id}指令
 * 进行装备操作
 */
export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const uid = e.uid as number;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;

  const identifier = parseEquipCommand(e.MessageText);

  if (!identifier) {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText('请指定要装备的装备名称或ID，例如：装备 青铜剑 或 装备 123');

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  try {
    const request = createBackendRequestContext(e);
    const result = await App({ messageText: e.MessageText, bid, uid, identifier, request });

    if (result.code === 'OK') {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText(`✅ ${result.data.message}`);
      md.addNewline();

      if (result.data.equipment) {
        const eq = result.data.equipment;

        md.addBlockquote(
          Format.createMarkdown()
            .addText(`装备名称：${eq.equipment.name}`)
            .addNewline()
            .addText(`品级：${eq.equipment.grade?.name ?? '未知'}`)
            .addNewline()
            .addText(`类型：${eq.equipment.equipmentType?.name ?? '未知'}`)
        );

        md.addBold('装备属性');
        md.addNewline();

        if (eq.physicalAttack && eq.physicalAttack > 0) {
          md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`物理攻击：${eq.physicalAttack}`));
        }
        if (eq.physicalAttackPercent && eq.physicalAttackPercent > 0) {
          md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`物理攻击加成：${+Number(eq.physicalAttackPercent).toFixed(2)}%`));
        }
        if (eq.magicAttack && eq.magicAttack > 0) {
          md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`法术攻击：${eq.magicAttack}`));
        }
        if (eq.magicAttackPercent && eq.magicAttackPercent > 0) {
          md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`法术攻击加成：${+Number(eq.magicAttackPercent).toFixed(2)}%`));
        }
        if (eq.physicalDefense && eq.physicalDefense > 0) {
          md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`物理防御：${eq.physicalDefense}`));
        }
        if (eq.physicalDefensePercent && eq.physicalDefensePercent > 0) {
          md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`物理防御加成：${+Number(eq.physicalDefensePercent).toFixed(2)}%`));
        }
        if (eq.magicDefense && eq.magicDefense > 0) {
          md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`法术防御：${eq.magicDefense}`));
        }
        if (eq.magicDefensePercent && eq.magicDefensePercent > 0) {
          md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`法术防御加成：${+Number(eq.magicDefensePercent).toFixed(2)}%`));
        }
        if (eq.hp && eq.hp > 0) {
          md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`生命：${eq.hp}`));
        }
        if (eq.hpPercent && eq.hpPercent > 0) {
          md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`生命加成：${+Number(eq.hpPercent).toFixed(2)}%`));
        }
        if (eq.speed && eq.speed > 0) {
          md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`速度：${eq.speed}`));
        }
        if (eq.critRate && eq.critRate > 0) {
          md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`暴击率：${+Number(eq.critRate).toFixed(2)}%`));
        }
        if (eq.critDamage && eq.critDamage > 0) {
          md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`暴击伤害：${+Number(eq.critDamage).toFixed(2)}%`));
        }
        md.addNewline();
      }

      md.addNewline();

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md, footer: [{ label: '我的装备', command: '/我的装备' }] }));
    } else {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();
      const repeatMsg = await withBackendRepeatDetection(bid, uid, e.MessageText, result.data.message, request);

      md.addText(`❌ ${repeatMsg}`);

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));
    }
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('装备操作失败:', error);
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText('装备操作失败，请稍后重试');

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));
  }
});
